summary: Portugal's golden visa (ARI, since 8 Oct 2012) is well documented: every threshold change is in the Diário da República, and SEF published one-page statistical maps (permits, family permits, top-5 nationalities, permits and investment by route) for every year 2012-2022 and monthly to September 2023, plus annual RIFA reports with top-10 nationalities. Since AIMA took over (29 Oct 2023) only annual totals, family permits and main nationalities are published, with no investment amounts or routes; AIMA's 2023 total (2 901) looks like a typo for 2,091. Citizenship rules tightened in 2026 (10 years' residence for most investors). No official counts of applications, renewals, pending files or naturalisations of ARI holders were found after 2014.

sources.title: 'Vistos gold' batem recorde em 2025, mas AIMA deixa de divulgar investimento captado
sources.covers: AIMA 2025 ARI figures; notes that AIMA no longer publishes investment amounts; cumulative totals since 2012.
sources.notes: Read through a text-extraction tool; quotes are as returned. ECO's figure of EUR 6,451 million "through 12,718 golden visas" mixes two SEF numbers: EUR 6,451m is real estate only; SEF's all-route total to Sep 2023 is EUR 7,318m.

events.title: Law 29/2012 creates the investment residence permit (ARI)
events.description: Amendment to the Foreigners Act (Law 23/2007) adds "investment activity" (capital transfer of EUR 1m, 30 jobs, or real estate of EUR 500k, kept for five years) and art. 90-A: residence permit without a residence visa, renewable, with family reunification.
events.quote: Aquisição de bens imóveis de valor igual ou superior a 500 mil euros

events.title: Golden visa (ARI) regime enters into force
events.description: Law 29/2012 entered into force 60 days after publication; the first two ARI permits were granted in 2012, both for capital transfers.
events.quote: em vigor desde o dia 8 de outubro de 2012

events.title: First ARI fees set: EUR 5,000 per permit
events.description: Portaria 305-A/2012 sets EUR 500 for analysis, EUR 5,000 to issue an investor or family permit and EUR 2,500 per renewal, in force 8 Oct 2012; issue and renewal revenue split equally between SEF and the Foreign Ministry's FRI.
events.quote: A presente portaria entra em vigor no dia 8 de outubro

events.title: Operação Labirinto: head of SEF and other officials detained
events.description: Police detain SEF director Manuel Jarmela Palos, IRN president António Figueiredo and Justice Ministry secretary-general Maria Antónia Anes in a corruption investigation linked to golden visas.
events.quote: António Figueiredo, Manuel Jarmela Palos e Maria Antónia Anes são detidos.

events.title: Interior minister Miguel Macedo resigns over golden-visa case
events.description: Minister of Internal Administration Miguel Macedo resigns, saying his authority was diminished, while denying responsibility.
events.quote: O ministro da Administração Interna anunciou este domingo a sua demissão do cargo

events.title: Inspectorate audit finds weak internal control in ARI processing
events.description: IGAI extraordinary audit (RELAT-122/2014) lists 20 findings, including inconsistent procedures, decisions taken on verbal instructions, and internal control that was "very incipient and weak"; ARI fees made up most of SEF fee revenue.
events.quote: Controlo interno muito incipiente e fraco, havendo inclusive áreas em que é ineficaz

events.title: New routes: rehabilitation, research, culture, funds; jobs cut to 10
events.description: Law 63/2015 (in force the day after its 30 Jun 2015 publication) adds subalíneas iv-vii (EUR 350k rehabilitation, EUR 350k research, EUR 250k culture, EUR 500k SME funds), lowers job creation to 10, and allows 20% lower amounts in low-density areas.
events.quote: Criação de, pelo menos, 10 postos de trabalho

events.title: Regulation sets proof rules and minimum stay (7 days, then 14 days per two years)
events.description: Decreto Regulamentar 15-A/2015 (published 2 Sep 2015, in force next day) regulates the new routes: co-ownership, mortgages above the threshold, leases allowed; minimum stay 7 days in the first year and 14 days in each later two-year period.
events.quote: b) 14 dias, seguidos ou interpolados, nos subsequentes períodos de dois anos.

events.title: Fund route lowered to EUR 350k; company-capital route added
events.description: Law 102/2017 (published 28 Aug 2017, in force 90 days later) lowers the fund route to EUR 350,000 and opens it to Portuguese funds with at least 60% invested in Portuguese companies; adds subalínea viii (EUR 350,000 company capital with five jobs).
events.quote: superior a € 350 000, destinados à constituição de uma sociedade comercial

events.title: Naturalisation after five years of legal residence (was six)
events.description: Organic Law 2/2018 cuts the legal-residence requirement for naturalisation from six to five years, which ARI holders can meet with the 7/14-day minimum stay (residence is counted by permit, not physical presence).
events.quote: b) Residirem legalmente no território português há pelo menos cinco anos;

events.title: Labirinto verdict: ex-minister acquitted, ex-IRN head convicted
events.description: First-instance court acquits Miguel Macedo and former SEF director Jarmela Palos; former IRN president António Figueiredo gets a suspended sentence of four years and seven months for corruption.
events.quote: Os três crimes valeram-lhe uma pena, em cúmulo, de quatro anos e sete meses de prisão, suspensa na execução.

events.title: Decree-law confines home purchases to the interior and islands and raises thresholds from 2022
events.description: DL 14/2021 (authorised by the 2020 budget law) raises capital transfer to EUR 1.5m and research, fund and company routes to EUR 500k, and limits residential real-estate ARIs to the Azores, Madeira and interior territories, from 1 Jan 2022; existing permits can be renewed.
events.quote: O presente decreto-lei entra em vigor a 1 de janeiro de 2022.

events.title: Coastal and big-city homes no longer qualify; higher minimums apply
events.description: DL 14/2021 takes effect: residential property in Lisbon, Porto and the coast no longer qualifies; capital transfer EUR 1.5m; research, funds, company EUR 500k.
events.quote: apenas permitem o acesso ao presente regime caso se situem nas Regiões Autónomas dos Açores e da Madeira ou nos territórios do interior

events.title: SEF abolished; AIMA takes over ARI
events.description: DL 41/2023 abolishes SEF and creates AIMA, in force 29 Oct 2023. SEF's monthly ARI maps (with investment amounts) end with September 2023; AIMA publishes only annual totals, family permits and main nationalities.
events.quote: entra em vigor a 29 de outubro de 2023

events.title: Mais Habitação: existing property-based permits convert on renewal
events.description: Law 56/2023 keeps pending applications and renewals under the old rules, but renewals of real-estate and capital-transfer ARIs convert them into entrepreneur-immigrant permits with the same 7/14-day stay; remaining routes may not invest in real estate.
events.quote: a renovação determina a conversão da autorização de residência numa autorização de residência para imigrantes empreendedores

events.title: Residence for naturalisation counted from the date the permit was applied for
events.description: Organic Law 1/2024 (in force on the first day of the month after publication on 5 Mar 2024) counts legal residence from the application for a temporary residence permit, if granted, which helped investors facing long ARI backlogs.
events.quote: considera-se igualmente o tempo decorrido desde o momento em que foi requerida a autorização de residência

events.title: Family reunification tightened, but ARI families exempt
events.description: Law 61/2025 requires two years of residence before family reunification, but exempts family members of holders of permits under arts. 90, 90-A (ARI) and 121-A.
events.quote: c) Membros da família do titular de autorização de residência concedida ao abrigo dos artigos 90.º, 90.º-A ou 121.º-A.

events.title: Constitutional Court strikes four norms of the new nationality law
events.description: Ruling 1133/2025 (preventive review requested by 50 MPs) finds unconstitutional the retroactive application to pending cases (art. 7(3)-(4) of Decree 17/XVII) and three other norms, but not the longer residence periods or the end of counting from the permit application.
events.quote: Pronuncia-se pela inconstitucionalidade da norma extraída dos n.ºs 3 e 4 do artigo 7.º do Decreto n.º 17/XVII

events.title: Naturalisation now needs 10 years of residence for most golden-visa holders
events.description: Organic Law 1/2026 requires 7 years of legal residence for CPLP and EU nationals and 10 years for others, revokes counting from the permit application date (art. 15(4)), and keeps the old law for procedures pending on entry into force (19 May 2026).
events.quote: ou 10 anos, no caso de nacionais de outros países

events.title: AIMA reports record 2,685 golden visas in 2025
events.description: AIMA's 2025 migration report shows 2,685 ARI permits and 3,967 family permits in 2025, led by US, Chinese and British nationals; it no longer reports investment amounts.
events.quote: foram concedidas 2.685 autorizações durante o ano de 2025

programs.name: Portugal Golden Visa (Autorização de Residência para Atividade de Investimento, ARI)
programs.notes: Residence permit for investment under art. 90-A of the Foreigners Act (Law 23/2007), created by Law 29/2012. Temporary permit (now two years, renewable for two-year periods) without a residence visa; minimum stay 7 days in the first year and 14 days in each later two-year period; family reunification. Routes over time: capital transfer (EUR 1m, then EUR 1.5m), job creation (30, then 10 jobs), real estate (EUR 500k), rehabilitation property (EUR 350k), research (EUR 350k, then 500k), culture (EUR 250k), funds (EUR 500k/350k/500k) and company capital with jobs (EUR 350k, then 500k). Residential property limited to the interior and islands from 2022; real estate and capital transfer closed to new applications by Law 56/2023 (Mais Habitação) from 7 Oct 2023. Run by SEF until 28 Oct 2023, then AIMA. Path to citizenship: naturalisation after 6 years of legal residence (2012-2018), 5 years (from 6 Jul 2018; from 1 Apr 2024 counted from the permit application), and from 19 May 2026 10 years (7 for CPLP/EU nationals), with pending applications kept under the old law. 12,718 investor permits and 20,424 family permits were granted under SEF (Oct 2012-Sep 2023), with EUR 7.32bn of reported investment.

gaps: Applications received, rejected and pending by year: only 2013-2014 figures (RIFA) and an approximate backlog for Dec 2014 (IGAI) were found; AIMA's large post-2023 ARI backlog is not quantified in any official document read.
Renewals of ARI permits and conversions under Law 56/2023: no official counts found.

Investment amounts and routes after September 2023: AIMA stopped publishing them (confirmed by ECO, Sept 2026). 2023 full-year route data missing; SEF monthly maps Jan-Aug 2023 exist (see leads) but were not read.
Full nationality breakdown: SEF and AIMA publish only the top 5-10 nationalities; no complete table found.
Naturalisations of ARI holders: no statistics found (IRN does not break naturalisations down by permit type).
